name: Mondelez Richmond Distribution Center - Sandston VA

fieldNotes.locate: Roster lat/lng was a GEOMETRIC_CENTER landing on open farmland 1.5 km from the actual building. Resolved via web research: the DC is at 953 S. Airport Drive in the Sauer Industrial Center, a Becknell build-to-suit just south of Richmond International Airport at the SR-895 / Airport Drive interchange. Locked to the southern of two large warehouses in the park (37.4798, -77.3382).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No clearly visible barrier arm, sliding gate, or staffed checkpoint at the property entrance in the available satellite imagery. The private access road off the SR-895 interchange feeds an open driveway/apron at the building's NW corner. Modern build-to-suit DCs commonly have a gate that may simply not be resolvable here, so this is flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at the entrance. The only small structure near the NW corner is a covered employee-entrance canopy on the building, not a gate-side booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate confirmed, so no remote check-in inferred; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Large cross-dock warehouse (~447,000 sq ft) with dock doors on the west, south and east faces; aggregate clearly 50+. Count of ~90 is an honest estimate from z18-z20 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive trailer drop yard on the SE side near the stormwater pond with multiple rows of marked stalls full of untethered trailers; 50+ band, ~90 capacity estimate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run on multiple distinct building faces (west bank vs east/south bank), consistent with separated ship/receive flows on a cross-dock layout; flagged uncertain since face roles cannot be confirmed from imagery.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Access road plus large open yard apron gives ample deep stacking for 3+ trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide private access road and large paved yard apron leave abundant unused width to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard apron inside the property before the dock faces functions as a holding/queue area.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-metro location: industrial park amid woods and farmland south of the airport, bordered by rural residential. Judged Rural per the small-town/edge-of-town rule.
fieldNotes.yardMetrics: Imagery is recent and clear; trailer and dock counts are honest overhead estimates and may vary.
